MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING
  MARCH 12, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  11:00 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins called the meeting to order at 11:00 am.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Pro Tem Marianne Riggins; and Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad,
  Bruce Silverstein and Steve Uhring.

  ABSENT: Mayor Doug Stewart

  ALSO PRESENT: Kellan Martz, Assistant City Attorney; Alexis Brown, Deputy City
  Manager; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Christina Munoz, Deputy City Clerk; and Tyler
  Eaton, Principal Planner

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Paul Grisanti led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Munoz reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  March 7, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Uhring moved, and Councilmember Conrad seconded a motion to
  approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  ORDINANCES AND PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  Local Coastal Program Amendment No. 25-001 and Zoning Text Amendment No.
  25-001  An amendment to the Malibu Local Coastal Program and Malibu
  Municipal Code Title 17 (Zoning) Modifying Standards and Procedures to
  Facilitate the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed by the 2025
  Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire
  Recommended Action: l) Conduct the Public Hearing; 2) Waive full reading of the
  ordinance; and 3) After the City Attorney reads the title of the ordinance, adopt on
  second reading Ordinance No. 524 approving Local Coastal Program Amendment
  No. 25-001, an amendment to the Local Coastal Program and Zoning Text
  Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to Title 17 (Zoning) of the Malibu
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of March 12, 2025
  Page 2 of 2

  Municipal Code updating regulations to facilitate the rebuilding of structures
  damaged or destroyed by natural disasters, including but not limited to, the 2025
  Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire to provide relief for those
  affected, and finding the amendments are exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act.

  Principal Planner Eaton presented the staff report and a PowerPoint presentation.

  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Paul Grisanti, Doug Burdge, Dean Wenner, Don Schmitz.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Pro Tem Riggins closed the public
  hearing and returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

  MOTIGN  Councilmember Conrad moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion to:
  1) Waive full reading ofthe ordinance; and 2) After the City Attomey reads the title
  of the ordinance, adopt on second reading Ordinance No. 524 approving Local
  ”W  Coastal Program Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to the Local Coastal
  Program and Zoning Text Amendment No. 25-001, an amendment to Title 17
't  (Zoning) of the Malibu Municipal Code updating regulations to facilitate the

  rebuilding of structures damaged or destroyed by natural disasters, including but
  not limited to, the 2025 Palisades Fire, 2024 Franklin Fire, and 2024 Broad Fire to
  provide relief for those affected, and finding the amendments are exempt from the
  California Environmental Quality Act. The question was called, and the motion
  carried 3-1-0, Councilmember Silverstein abstained and Mayor Stewart absent.

  ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Pro Tem Riggins adjourned the meeting at 11:38 a.m.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on July 14, 2025.
